ingredients.name: tart apples, cored, peeled and chopped

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Lightly oil a 13 by 9 by 2 inch pan.
Mix 5 cups of apples, 1 cup of sugar, 1 cup of raisins and 1/2 cup of pecans.
steps.spoken: Mix 5 cups of apples, 1 cup of sugar, 1 cup of raisins and 1/2 cup of pecans. In a large mixing bowl, combine the apples with the sugar, raisins and pecans. Mix well.

steps.instruction: Let the apple mixture stand for 30 minutes.
Stir in 1/4 cup of oil, 2 teaspoons of vanilla and the beaten egg.
Sift together 2 1/2 cups flour, 1 1/2 teaspoons baking soda and 2 teaspoons cinnamon.
Stir the flour mixture into the apple mixture, about 1/3 at a time.
steps.spoken: Stir the flour mixture into the apple mixture about 1/3 at a time, just enough to moisten the dry ingredients.

steps.instruction: Turn the batter into the pan.
Bake for 35 minutes.
steps.spoken: Bake for 35 to forty minutes.

steps.instruction: Cool the cake slightly before serving.
steps.spoken: Cool the cake slightly before serving. This makes 20 servings.

steps.instruction: Put 1 piece of beef bouillon in 2 cups of hot water in a small bowl.
Stir until the bouillon dissolves.
steps.spoken: Stir until the bouillon dissolves. This makes 2 cups of beef broth.

steps.instruction: Mix the broth and 1 tablespoon of orange juice in a medium bowl.
Stir in 1/4 teaspoon of allspice and 1/8 teaspoon of black pepper.
Peel and chop 1 onion to make 1/2 cup.
Put 2 tablespoons of water in a large skillet and heat on medium.
Add the onion and simmer until tender.
Add 2 1/2 pounds of beef chuck roast to the skillet.
Brown the roast on all sides.
Pour the broth mixture over the meat in the skillet.
Cover and simmer for 2 hours.

ingredients.name: cooked black beans, mashed or low-sodium canned

steps.instruction: Mash 1 1/3 cups of black beans with 1 teaspoon of canola oil.
Mix in 2 tablespoons of chopped onion and 1/2 cup of chopped tomatoes.
Place 4 corn tortillas between two sheets of slightly damp white paper towels.
Microwave on high for 15 seconds.
Divide the bean mixture between the tortillas.
Fold each tortilla to enclose the filling.
Place the burritos on a microwave-safe dish.
Spoon 1/2 cup of fresh tomato salsa over the burritos.
Microwave on high for 15 seconds.
Top with 4 tablespoons of yogurt and 2 tablespoons of chopped cilantro.

black-bean-soup-and-salsa-verde.title: Black Bean Soup and Salsa Verde

ingredients.name: Mexican salsa verde, or to taste
packed cilantro leaves, plus extra sprigs for garnish, optional

steps.instruction: Add 2 cans of drained black beans to a blender.
Add 1 1/2 cups of chicken broth and 1 cup of salsa verde.
Add 1/4 cup of cilantro leaves and 1 teaspoon of ground cumin.
steps.spoken: Add 1/4 cup of packed cilantro leaves, if you like, and 1 teaspoon of ground cumin.

steps.instruction: Blend until smooth.
Pour into a large saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Simmer, partly covered, for 5 minutes, stirring often.
steps.spoken: Simmer, partly covered, for 5 to 7 minutes, stirring often, to blend the flavors.

steps.instruction: Top each bowl with 1 tablespoon of tortilla chips and 1 tablespoon of sour cream.
steps.spoken: Top each bowl with 1 tablespoon of tortilla chips and 1 tablespoon of sour cream. Add a few cilantro sprigs if you like.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 400 °F.
Mix 1 3/4 cups of pumpkin and 1 1/2 cups of brown sugar thoroughly.
Mix in 2 eggs and 1/2 cup of vegetable oil thoroughly.
Blend 1 1/2 cups flour, 1 1/4 cups whole wheat flour and 1 tablespoon baking powder.
Blend in 2 teaspoons of cinnamon and 1 teaspoon of nutmeg.
Blend in 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/4 teaspoon of ground ginger.
Add the dry mixture to the pumpkin mixture.
Add 1 cup of raisins and 1 cup of chopped walnuts.
Drop the dough by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes, until golden brown. Makes 48 cookies.
steps.spoken: Bake for 10 to 12 minutes, until golden brown. This makes 48 cookies.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Community Fit!, South Haven Health System

steps.instruction: Cook 3/4 cup of orzo pasta by the package directions, then drain it.
Rinse the orzo with cold water.
Whisk 1 tablespoon of lemon juice and 2 tablespoons of vinegar in a small bowl.
Whisk in 2 tablespoons of olive oil, 1 teaspoon of sugar and 1 teaspoon of poppy seeds.
Put the orzo and 2 cups of chopped broccoli in a large bowl.
Add 2 cups of diced strawberries and 1/4 cup of sunflower seeds.
Drizzle with the lemon poppy seed dressing and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper.
Chill in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: University of Connecticut Family Nutrition Program, Senior Nutrition Awareness Project (SNAP) Newsletters

steps.instruction: Trim 2 cups of Brussels sprouts and cut them in half.
Steam the Brussels sprouts until tender.
steps.spoken: Steam them for about 6 to ten minutes, until tender. Or microwave on high for three to four minutes.

steps.instruction: Bring 1/2 cup of chicken broth to a boil in a non-stick pot.
Mix in 1 teaspoon lemon juice, 1 teaspoon mustard and 1/2 teaspoon dried thyme.
Add 1/2 cup of sliced mushrooms.
Boil until the broth is reduced by half.
steps.spoken: Boil about 5 to eight minutes, until the broth has reduced by half.

steps.instruction: Add the cooked Brussels sprouts to the sauce.
Toss well to coat with the sauce.
Put 6 cups of water, 1 tablespoon of salt and 1 chopped onion in a pot.
Add 1 whole chicken, about 3 pounds, to the pot.
Boil for 1 hour, until the chicken is tender.
steps.spoken: Boil for about 1 hour, until the chicken is tender.

steps.instruction: Take the chicken out of the pot and let it cool.
Take the meat off the bones.
Chop the meat into bite-sized pieces.
Skim the fat off the juices in the pot.
Measure 3 1/2 cups of the broth into a 6-quart saucepan.
Add 1 cup of long-grain rice and the chicken pieces.
Add 1/2 pound of sliced smoked sausage.
Add 2 tablespoons of herb seasoning and 1 packet of chicken and herb seasoning.
Bring the pan to a boil.
Lower the heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes. Keep the pan covered the entire time. If the rice mixture is too wet, cook it uncovered until it is the thickness you like.

steps.instruction: Place half of the bread cubes in a well greased 9 by 9 inch pan.
Top with 1 1/2 cups of cooked broccoli and 1 cup of shredded cheddar cheese.
Add 1 tablespoon of minced onion, if you like, and 1 cup of diced cooked chicken.
Place the rest of the bread cubes on top.
In a bowl, mix 3 eggs, 4 egg whites and 2 cups of milk.
Pour the egg mixture over the bread in the pan.
Cover the pan and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Cover the pan and refrigerate overnight, or for at least 1 hour.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 325 °F.
Bake uncovered for 1 hour, until the center is firm and lightly browned.
steps.spoken: Bake uncovered for 1 to 1 1/4 hours, until the center is firm and lightly browned.

ingredients.name: semi-sweet chocolate morsels or chocolate chips

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 375 °F.
Cream 2 sticks of softened butter with 1 cup of granulated white sugar.
Add 1 cup of packed brown sugar and cream again.
Beat in 2 extra-large eggs and 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract.
Sift in 2 cups of all-purpose flour and 2 cups of oat flour.
Sift in 1/2 teaspoon of salt, 1 teaspoon baking powder and 1 teaspoon baking soda.
Stir in 2 cups of chocolate chips and 4 ounces of grated milk chocolate.
Stir in 3 cups of chopped nuts, if you like.
Roll the dough into balls and place them 2 inches apart on a cookie sheet.
Bake for 10 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 10 minutes, or until golden brown. Baking times may vary.

steps.instruction: Let the cookies stand 1 minute, then move them to a plate or cooling sheet.
Pour 18 ounces of corn flour into 3 quarts of cold water.
Stir with a whisk until no lumps remain.
Heat until boiling, stirring slowly with a big spoon.
Cook on low heat for 1 hour, stirring very often.
steps.spoken: Cook on low heat for about 1 hour. Stir very often. If it gets too thick, add water.

steps.instruction: Season with salt to taste.
Heat the oven to 400 °F.
Scoop the seeds from 4 small zucchini, halved lengthwise, with a teaspoon.
Mix 1 cup of cornbread, 1/2 teaspoon of salt and 1/2 teaspoon of pepper.
Mix in the yolks from 4 eggs and 1/2 cup of cream cheese.
Whip the 4 egg whites with 1/8 teaspoon of cream of tartar until stiff.
Stir 1/4 of the egg whites into the cornbread mixture.
Gently fold in the rest of the egg whites.
Fill the scooped part of each zucchini half with the mixture.
Mix the other 1 cup of cornbread with 1 1/2 cups of Monterey Jack cheese.
Sprinkle the cornbread and cheese over each zucchini half.
Bake for 30 minutes, until browned and bubbly on top.
steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to 35 minutes, until the top is browned and bubbly.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 325 °F.
Put 1 package of frozen corn into a blender.
Add 1 cup of milk, 3 eggs, 2 tablespoons of sugar and 1/8 teaspoon of salt.
Blend on medium until everything is mixed thoroughly.
Pour into a medium baking dish coated with cooking spray.
Dot the top with 1 tablespoon of butter, cut into 6 pieces.
Bake for 70 minutes.
In a bowl, mix 1/2 cup of sour cream and 2 tablespoons of cider vinegar.
Mix in 1 teaspoon of sugar, 3/4 teaspoon of garlic powder and 3/4 teaspoon of dill weed.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon of salt.
Add 3 sliced cucumbers and 1/2 cup of sliced onion.
Toss to coat the vegetables.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
Serve the salad with a slotted spoon.

ingredients.name: jalapeño pepper, seeded and finely chopped, optional

steps.instruction: Combine 4 diced tomatoes and 1 small, finely chopped onion in a bowl.
Add 1 seeded, finely chopped jalapeño pepper if you want spice.
In a small bowl, whisk 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice.
Whisk in 1 teaspoon of Dijon mustard.
Whisk in 1 teaspoon of honey or sugar, if using, and a pinch of salt.
Pour the dressing over the tomato mixture and toss gently.
Taste, and add more salt, lemon juice or honey if you like.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, so the flavors blend.

steps.instruction: Top with chopped fresh cilantro or parsley.
Peel 8 pounds of potatoes.
Slice the potatoes into small or large wedges.
Heat 1/2 quart of vegetable oil in a pan to 350 °F.
Fry the potatoes in the oil until light brown.
Season the potatoes with salt to taste.
Fry 2 1/2 pounds of small chicken pieces for 5 minutes.
Drain the oil or move the chicken to a different pan.
Season the chicken with salt.
Add 3/4 cup of water and simmer the chicken for 15 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 3/4 cup of water and simmer the chicken for 15 to 20 minutes. Wash your hands after handling the raw chicken.

steps.instruction: Put the chicken and potatoes together, with the potatoes on top.
Add cumin to taste and simmer for about 20 minutes.
Melt 1 cup of butter in a large pot over medium heat.
Add 2 cups of semolina and stir for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 2 cups of semolina and stir all the time for about 10 minutes, until it turns golden brown and smells nutty.

steps.instruction: Turn the heat down to low.
Add 1 cup of sugar and 1 teaspoon of ground cardamom, and mix well.
Slowly pour in 1 cup of milk, stirring all the time.
steps.spoken: Slowly pour in 1 cup of milk. Keep stirring so no lumps form.

steps.instruction: Keep cooking and stirring the mixture for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Keep cooking and stirring for 10 to 15 minutes, until it thickens and pulls away from the sides of the pot. It should be smooth and creamy.

steps.instruction: Take the pot off the heat and let it cool a little.
Spoon the pudding into bowls or onto a large platter.
Smooth the top with the back of a spoon.
Sprinkle ground cinnamon and chopped nuts on top, if you like.
steps.spoken: If you like, sprinkle ground cinnamon and chopped nuts on top. Serve it warm or at room temperature.

ingredients.name: elbow macaroni pasta, cooked, drained and chilled

steps.instruction: Whisk 1/2 cup of mayonnaise and 1 teaspoon of dry mustard in a small bowl.
Whisk in 1 teaspoon of sugar and 2 tablespoons of cider vinegar.
Add salt and pepper to taste.
Toss 1 pound of pasta, 1/3 cup of red onion and 1/3 cup of celery.
steps.spoken: In a large bowl, toss 1 pound of cooked, drained and chilled elbow macaroni with 1/3 cup of chopped red onion and 1/3 cup of chopped celery.

steps.instruction: Pour the dressing over the top and toss to combine.
Cool the salad before serving.
Bring 3 cups of water to a boil in a saucepan.
Slowly add 1 cup of millet flour, stirring all the time.
steps.spoken: Slowly add 1 cup of millet flour to the boiling water, stirring all the time so no lumps form.

steps.instruction: Turn the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes, stirring now and then.
Add a pinch of salt and keep stirring.
Take the pan off the heat and let the porridge cool to room temperature.
Cover the porridge with a clean cloth and let it ferment overnight.
steps.spoken: Cover the porridge with a clean cloth and leave it to ferment overnight, for at least 8 hours.

steps.instruction: The next morning, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a separate pan.
Pour the porridge into the pan and heat it over medium heat, stirring.
steps.spoken: Pour the porridge into the pan and heat it over medium heat, stirring all the time, until it is as thick as you like. You can add more water for a thinner porridge.

steps.instruction: Serve warm in a bowl.
Spread 1 pound of raw pre-shelled peanuts on a large baking sheet.
Roast the peanuts in the oven at 350 °F for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Roast the peanuts in the oven at 350 °F for 10 to twelve minutes.

steps.instruction: While the peanuts are hot, wrap a few handfuls in a dish towel.
Roll the peanuts against each other in the towel to rub off the skins.
steps.spoken: Roll the peanuts against each other in the towel for several seconds to rub off the skins. Do this while they are still hot.

steps.instruction: Put the skinned peanuts in a food processor, with salt if you like.
Chop until the peanut butter is as thick as you like.
steps.spoken: Chop the peanuts until the peanut butter is as thick as you like. This may take a few minutes.

ingredients.name: dried red chilies or cayenne pepper
fresh cilantro, chopped and lightly packed

steps.instruction: Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a soup pot.
Add 1 medium yellow onion and saute for 5 minutes.
Add 4 cloves of garlic and 1 tablespoon of ginger, and saute 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 4 cloves of minced garlic and 1 tablespoon of grated ginger, and saute for 5 more minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2 tablespoons of curry powder and 1 teaspoon of salt.
Add 1/4 teaspoon of cinnamon and chilies to taste, and saute 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 1/4 teaspoon of ground cinnamon and dried red chilies or cayenne pepper to taste, and saute for 5 more minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 4 cups of water and stir.
Add 5 chopped plum tomatoes and 1 cup of dried red lentils.
Bring to a boil, then lower the heat a bit.
Simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the juice of 1 lemon and 1 cup of chopped cilantro.
Add a little more water if the dahl is too thick.
Simmer 10 more minutes, until the lentils are fully tender.
steps.spoken: Simmer 10 more minutes, until the lentils are fully tender. This may take a while.

steps.instruction: Fry 2 chopped red onions in a splash of olive oil in a deep frying pan.
Add the meat from 6 spicy Italian sausages, casings removed.
Add 1 sprig of chopped rosemary needles and 1 diced, deseeded red chili.
Turn up the heat and break up the sausage meat with a wooden spoon.
Once the meat has browned, pour in 1 cup of red wine.
Cook until the wine has reduced by half.
Add 2 cans of chopped plum tomatoes.
Cook the sauce uncovered for 30 minutes, until it has reduced.
steps.spoken: Cook the sauce uncovered for about 30 minutes, until it has reduced.

steps.instruction: Cook 10 ounces of pasta as the package says.
Grate 1/2 cup of parmesan into a bowl.
Drain the pasta and stir it into the sauce.
Stir in the parmesan, 1 1/4 cups of heavy cream and seasoning to taste.
Beat 2 eggs in a bowl.
Heat 2 cups of broth in a pot until it boils.
Pour the eggs into the broth, leaving the pot on the heat.
Stir with a whisk until the eggs set into strands.
Pour the broth and eggs into a bowl.
Drizzle with olive oil, if you like.
In a mixing bowl, combine 1 finely chopped onion and 2 cloves of minced garlic.
Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and the juice of 1 lemon.
Add 1 teaspoon each of paprika, cayenne pepper, ground cumin and ground coriander.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt and mix well to make a marinade.
Add 2 pounds of beef pieces and toss until evenly coated.
Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour.
steps.spoken: Cover the bowl with plastic wrap or a lid and let the beef marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour, or preferably overnight.

steps.instruction: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: If you are using wooden skewers, soak them in water for about 30 minutes, so they don't burn on the grill.

steps.instruction: Heat the grill to medium-high.
Thread the beef onto the skewers, evenly spaced.
Grill the skewers for 8 minutes, turning occasionally.
steps.spoken: Grill the skewers for about 8 to 10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is charred and cooked the way you like it.

steps.instruction: Take the skewers off the grill and let them rest a few minutes before serving.
